SELECT
    country,
    origin,
    system,
    status,
    url,
    date_recorded,
    "sysID" as sysid,
    "imageID" as imageid,
    "statusID" as statusid,
    "matID" as matid,
    
    CASE
        /* Combat Aircraft */
        WHEN system ~* 'F-\d+|MiG|Su-|Rafale|Typhoon|Gripen|J-\d+|Kfir' THEN 'Combat Aircraft'
        WHEN system ~* 'B-\d+|Tu-\d+|H-6|Vulcan|Backfire' THEN 'Combat Aircraft'
        WHEN system ~* 'A-\d+|Su-25|Warthog|Frogfoot' THEN 'Combat Aircraft'
        WHEN system ~* 'L-39|Su-\d+|MiG-\d+' THEN 'Combat Aircraft'

        /* Support Aircraft */
        WHEN system ~* 'C-\d+|Il-\d+|An-\d+|KC-\d+|A\d+\d+M|Hercules' THEN 'Support Aircraft'
        WHEN system ~* 'E-\d+|RC-\d+|U-2|SR-71|AWACS|Hawkeye' THEN 'Support Aircraft'
        WHEN system ~* 'P-\d+|P-8|Tu-142|Orion|Poseidon' THEN 'Support Aircraft'
        WHEN system ~* 'EA-\d+|EF-\d+|Growler|Prowler' THEN 'Support Aircraft'
        WHEN system ~* 'KC-135|Il-78|A330 MRTT' THEN 'Support Aircraft'

        /* Helicopter */
        WHEN system ~* 'AH-\d+|Ka-\d+|Mi-\d+|Apache|Cobra|Hind' THEN 'Helicopter'
        WHEN system ~* 'UH-\d+|CH-\d+|Mi-8|Chinook|Blackhawk|Helecopter' THEN 'Helicopter'

        /* UAV/Drone */
        WHEN system ~* 'UAV|RQ-\d+|MQ-\d+|Predator|Reaper|Global Hawk|Bayraktar|Orlan' THEN 'UAV/Drone'
        WHEN system ~* 'TB2|Orlan-\d+|Mohajer-\d+|Forpost|ScanEagle' THEN 'UAV/Drone'

        /* Armored Fighting Vehicle */
        WHEN system ~* 'T-\d+|Abrams|Leopard|Challenger|Merkava' THEN 'Armored Fighting Vehicle'
        WHEN system ~* 'BMP|Bradley|Warrior|Puma' THEN 'Armored Fighting Vehicle'
        WHEN system ~* 'M113|BTR|Stryker|VAB' THEN 'Armored Fighting Vehicle'
        WHEN system ~* 'T-\d+|Unknown tank' THEN 'Armored Fighting Vehicle'
        WHEN system ~* 'BMP-\d+|BMD-\d+|BRM-\d+' THEN 'Armored Fighting Vehicle'
        WHEN system ~* 'MT-LB|BTR-\d+' THEN 'Armored Fighting Vehicle'

        /* Artillery */
        WHEN system ~* 'M109|PzH|CAESAR|Archer' THEN 'Artillery'
        WHEN system ~* 'MLRS|Grad|Smerch|HIMARS' THEN 'Artillery'
        WHEN system ~* 'M777|2S19|FH70' THEN 'Artillery'
        WHEN system ~* '2S1|2S3|2S5|2S7|2S9|2S19|2S22|2S23|2S33|2S34' THEN 'Artillery'
        WHEN system ~* 'D-20|D-30|D-44|2A36|2A65|M777|FH70|TRF1' THEN 'Artillery'
        WHEN system ~* '2B9|2B11|2B16|2S12|M120K' THEN 'Artillery'
        WHEN system ~* 'BM-21|BM-27|BM-30|TOS-1A|2B17|RM-70' THEN 'Artillery'
        WHEN system ~* '155mm|howitzer|2A65 Msta-B|2S1 Gvozdika|2S3 Akatsiya|2S19 Msta-S|M109|M777|FH70|D-20|D-30|2S22 Bohdana|ShKH vz\. 77 DANA|AHS Krab|PzH 2000|G6|CAESAR|Archer' THEN 'Artillery'

        /* Support Vehicle */
        WHEN system ~* 'Fennek|BRDM|Fuchs' THEN 'Support Vehicle'
        WHEN system ~* 'GAZ Tigr|International MaxxPro|Mastiff|Wolfhound|Husky|Kozak|Roshel Senator|MaxxPro' THEN 'Support Vehicle'
        WHEN system ~* 'UAZ-469|HMMWV' THEN 'Support Vehicle'
        WHEN system ~* 'Ural-\d+|KamAZ|GAZ-\d+|KrAZ|truck|ural' THEN 'Support Vehicle'
        WHEN system ~* 'BREM-\d+|IMR-\d+|MTP-\d+' THEN 'Support Vehicle'
        WHEN system ~* 'armoured\ recovery\ vehicle' THEN 'Support Vehicle'
        WHEN system ~* 'R-\d+|1L\d+|9S\d+|forward\ observer\ vehicle|battery\ fire\ control\ center' THEN 'Support Vehicle'
        WHEN system ~* 'PMP|TMM-\d+' THEN 'Support Vehicle'

        /* Naval Vessels */
        WHEN system ~* 'CVN-|Admiral Kuznetsov|Queen Elizabeth' THEN 'Capital Ship'
        WHEN system ~* 'DDG-|Type 052|Arleigh Burke' THEN 'Capital Ship'
        WHEN system ~* 'SSN-|SSBN-|Akula|Typhoon|Astute' THEN 'Submarine'
        WHEN system ~* 'FFG-|Type 054|FREMM' THEN 'Small Surface Combatant'
        WHEN system ~* 'Corvette|Buyan-M|Visby' THEN 'Small Surface Combatant'
        WHEN system ~* 'Patrol Boat|Dvora|CB90' THEN 'Small Surface Combatant'
        WHEN system ~* 'LHD-|Mistral|Wasp' THEN 'Amphibious Warfare Ship'
        WHEN system ~* 'Project \d+|Class' THEN 'Naval Vessel'

        /* Weapon Systems */
        WHEN system ~* 'ZSU-23|Gepard|Tunguska' THEN 'Air Defense System'
        WHEN system ~* 'S-300|S-400|Patriot|THAAD' THEN 'Air Defense System'
        WHEN system ~* 'Pantsir|Tor|Buk' THEN 'Air Defense System'
        WHEN system ~* 'Javelin|Kornet|NLAW|TOW' THEN 'Anti-Tank System'
        WHEN system ~* '9K\d+|9M\d+|Metis|Konkurs' THEN 'Anti-Tank System'
        WHEN system ~* 'Tomahawk|Kalibr|Kh-101' THEN 'Missile'
        WHEN system ~* 'Iskander|Scud|Hwasong' THEN 'Missile'

        /* Electronic Warfare and Command Systems */
        WHEN system ~* 'Krasukha|Murmansk-BN|EA-18G' THEN 'Electronic Warfare and Command System'
        WHEN system ~* 'AN/SPY-1|AESA|Nebo|radar' THEN 'Electronic Warfare and Command System'
        WHEN system ~* 'AWACS|E-3|A-50' THEN 'Electronic Warfare and Command System'

        /* Unmanned Ground Vehicle */
        WHEN system ~* 'Uran-9|THeMIS|MUTT' THEN 'Unmanned Ground Vehicle'

        /* Amphibious Vehicle */
        WHEN system ~* 'AAV-7|BMP-3F|Type 05' THEN 'Amphibious Vehicle'

        /* Naval Support */
        WHEN system ~* 'Avenger-class|Tripartite|Katanpää' THEN 'Naval Support Vessel'
        WHEN system ~* 'LCAC|LCU|Type 726' THEN 'Naval Support Vessel'
        WHEN system ~* 'van|vehicle' THEN 'Unknown Vehicle'

        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END
 AS predicted_category
FROM "dbt_equipment_losses"."public"."equipment_losses"

SELECT DISTINCT system
FROM "dbt_equipment_losses"."public"."equipment_analysis"
WHERE predicted_category = 'Unknown'

WITH daily_losses AS (
    SELECT
        date_recorded,
        country,
        predicted_category,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_loss_count
    FROM "dbt_equipment_losses"."public"."equipment_analysis"
    GROUP BY date_recorded, country, predicted_category
),

cumulative_losses AS (
    SELECT
        date_recorded,
        country,
        predicted_category,
        daily_loss_count,
        SUM(daily_loss_count) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, predicted_category
            ORDER BY date_recorded
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_loss_count
    FROM daily_losses
)

SELECT
    date_recorded,
    country,
    predicted_category,
    daily_loss_count,
    cumulative_loss_count
FROM cumulative_losses
ORDER BY country, predicted_category, date_recorded
